cousin of CMY

Elder sister of [Anne Baker](/person/97), she was the daughter of Major Thomas Richard Baker (1802-1884), J.P., 7th Fusiliers, Rtd. and Mary Frances Anderson Morshead (d. 1843), whose grandmother Elizabeth Yonge was a sister of CMY\'s grandfather. [LG 1906 Baker of Bayfordbury for parents]
